resolved_conflicts.explanation: The association's list files the structure as a tower; the two pages describe a 35-foot pole platform. The story uses the pages' wording and notes the list's label.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three pages. Two carry the same 1930 and 1930s dates, and one credits Kresek, so the dates probably rest on one lineage. A web search on the name found nothing about this lookout. idahofirelookouts.com (https://www.idahofirelookouts.com/northern-idaho/nickleplate-mountain-lookout/) gives the same 1930 and 1930s dates but is not cited; its text uses typographic characters. It says no staffing history is documented, so staffing is left out. No source gives access or visit details, so those are left out. The 35-foot height is converted to 10.7 m, matching the record.
